fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Owning Project.ItemId — kept alongside environmentId so the flat gateway filter {projectId, environmentId} works (the gateway has no joins).

fields.name: environmentId
fields.description: Owning Environment.ItemId. Checks are env-scoped: every check (built-in seed or user-defined) is one row per environment, so definition and selection live on the same row.

fields.name: source
fields.description: builtin | custom. 'builtin' rows are seeded from the shipped 11-check catalog; 'custom' rows are user-defined.

fields.name: checkId
fields.description: Row identity within the env: the stable catalog id (page_load, navigation, ...) for builtin rows, or the custom_<slug> id for custom rows. The migration and the toggle hook dedup/match on (environmentId, checkId) — never on label, which is editable.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Check name shown in the Scopes page list.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the check does — the AI agent uses this as guidance during a verification run.

fields.name: recommended
fields.description: true | false (string — Blocks Data fields are primitives). Seeding default for `enabled`.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: true | false (string). The per-env selection: only enabled checks run in this environment's verification runs. Replaces UserPreference.customChecksJson selection storage and Environment.checksJson.
